title: WATCHTOWER
tagline: a static file server with a real STOP
usage:
SERVE runs python's http.server on the dialled PORT from the aimed project — a true long-runner, RUN stays lit until STOP. The start IN demands the stop IN beside it: anything a cable can start, a cable must be able to stop (the transport law).
Patch a build device's DONE into START to serve fresh output, and OUT into MONITOR for the request log.
